annotations.title: Start, stop or reboot a server

description: Power action on a VPS, Windows RDP or dedicated server on the account: start, reboot, shutdown (graceful) or poweroff (hard, like pulling the plug). Interrupts whatever runs on the server, so it needs confirm: true after the customer approves. At most 6 actions per server per 10 minutes.

confirm.description: Must be true. Set it only after the customer has explicitly confirmed this exact change.

service_id.description: Server (VPS, Windows RDP or dedicated) service id, as returned by the matching list tool.

name: server_power
